The main takeaway from our work is that

the diagonal multi-matrix correlators are in a sense the most natural objects to consider when studying the large N limit of = 4 gauge theory, since the diagonal multi-matrices form a basis for the Hilbert space.

the diagonal free field basis of multi-matrices operators can be constructed in terms of Clebsh-Gordan coefficients for decomposing tensor products of representations of the global symmetry of the theory.
the 1-loop action of the dilatation operator can be written in terms of Clebsh multiplicities of the tensor product decomposition of the symmetric group representations.
